use: Read absorbance / fluorescence of every well of a 96-well plate (enzyme kinetics, OD600).
simulation: Absorbance per well via Beer–Lambert (short path); temperature and kinetic read interval can be set.
notes: Reference model profile: multi-mode microplate reader (BioTek Synergy class, absorbance mode). Specs not individually verified (verified = false).
sources: BioTek Synergy H1 product literature (to be archived and checked)

read.description: Read all wells in the instrument (~15 s); result plate = [{well, A}] (includes plate background, subtract blank wells)
